quantitative_evaluation.regime_label_method: Analyst-assigned from official daily OHLC and dated post-close report of early oscillation, recovery, and late strength; no fixed intraday classifier is supplied. Not a full minute-series verification.
quantitative_evaluation.metric_notes: Direction is up above +5bp, down below -5bp, flat otherwise. Base scenario is close return between -50bp and +50bp. Single-day calibration error and baseline lift unavailable.

market_view.note: Small positive open and mixed session align with cautious view, but sector leadership was narrower/different than the large-cap/semiconductor framing.

open_hypothesis.note: Small positive open realized at +7.69bp, below forecast +25bp.

intraday_hypothesis.note: Early two-way movement, a low below prior close, and recovery to positive near the high fit range-with-late-strength; range label is manual, not minute-series validated.

close_hypothesis.note: Actual +25.28bp remained a modest positive return but exceeded the configured flat band; flat direction target missed.

breadth_hypothesis.note: 483 up versus 506 down validates weak aggregate breadth, but Taiwan50 -0.02% versus midcap +1.00% and smallcap +0.86% contradicts large caps outperforming ordinary stocks.

bull_script.note: Mid/small-cap and some electronic component strength occurred, but semiconductor index fell 0.18% and aggregate listed breadth stayed negative; complete broad semiconductor-led bull conditions not demonstrated.

base_script.note: Small positive open, oscillation and modest positive finish match base numeric outcome. Claim that semiconductor leadership would support index is not supported by semiconductor -0.18%.

bear_script.note: The market crossed below prior close intraday but recovered; a below-prior-close finish did not occur.

key_drivers.note: Official sector returns support selective rotation, not dominant semiconductor strength. Overnight values and causal oil/yield effects not independently revalidated in this evaluation.

invalidation_conditions.note: Opening gap neither exceeded +80bp nor became negative. 09:15-09:30 VWAP/opening-range/breadth conjunctions cannot be verified without minute-level evidence; no hindsight scenario upgrade performed.

actual_driver_attribution.detail: Electronic components +2.21%, midcaps +1.00%, smallcaps +0.86%, ex-financial/electronics +0.79%; Taiwan50 -0.02% and semiconductor -0.18%. Selective rotation rather than broad heavyweight semiconductor leadership.
Dated post-close report describes early oscillation, recovery and rising close. Attribution to oil/yields is not causally established.

proposed_model_changes.proposal: Calibrate cash-open gap magnitude separately from overnight directional signals.
Separate count breadth from cap-size and sector-relative performance; weak advancing counts do not prove heavyweight leadership.
Persist and read-back-verify prediction before open; report generated versus persisted states independently and preserve delayed records as a separate benchmark cohort.

model_change_gate.reason: One observation plus delayed-persistence provenance does not justify fitting new trading rules.
